text:
maya: quick follow-up from the fragmentation postmortem — can we lock owners for the action items in the frag-ledger?
maya: i created a thin spreadsheet (link: https://redwood.internal/frag-ledger) with rows: owner, ticket, mitigation, ETA, checkpoints. please add yourself to the rows you own by EOD Wed.
liam: @maya added myself to 'eviction-policy experiment' and 'kv-alloc tracing'. will add notes from the profiler run.
alex: @liam can you paste the perf counters you used? i want to wire them into the dashboard.
liam: sure — small paste below
liam: ```
perf_counters:
  kv_alloc_rate: 12k/s
  kv_free_rate: 3.2k/s
  frag_ratio: 0.42
  slab_miss_pct: 8.1
``` 
sam: noted — i'm taking 'compact-on-idle' trial and will run it on canary next Tue. ETA end of week for initial numbers.
maya: thanks. proposal: weekly 30m checkouts on Mon 10am PST to review metrics + owner blockers. good? :calendar:
alex: +1, will add a dashboard tab with trend + rolling percentiles.
infra-bot: alert: OOM spike detected on rtx-serve-12 at 2024-05-25T14:12:07Z — 7 instances affected — incident created #INC-4872
maya: thanks infra-bot. adding INC-4872 to the ledger row. @sam pls correlate canary results with that timeline.
sam: will do — initial look shows KV growth preceding the OOM by ~8 mins, attaching snippet:
sam: ```
# tail -n 50 /var/log/serve/alloc.log
[14:03:12] kv_alloc +14M
[14:06:01] kv_alloc +20M
[14:10:50] gc_triggered: false
[14:11:59] kv_alloc +32M
[14:12:07] OOM
```
liam: if gc_triggered is false there might be a config gap w/ our fragmentation-safe GC thresholds. adding a followup ticket.
maya: ok owners so far: liam (tracing + eviction experiment), alex (dash + alerts), sam (compact trial + correlation). i'll own the communication & postmortem follow-through. i'll send calendar invites after owners confirm.
alex: edge ask — can we add a small synthetic workload to reproduce the fragment+oom in CI? if so i can script it and attach to the ledger.
liam: i can help write the workload generator. @maya put it in the 'repro' row.
maya: done. final ask: owners please drop 1-line weekly status in the sheet before the Mon sync so we can keep the meeting short. :thumbsup:
maya: thanks everyone — will close this thread once owners are all confirmed.
filename_note: Generated slack thread for frag ledger weekly checkouts
